question: By what factors have LIB energy density risen and battery cost fallen, between the starting points the review gives and 2020?
expect: energy density 150 to 250 Wh/kg since 1991 (1.7 times); cost from over $1000/kWh in 2008 to around $130/kWh in 2020 (7.7 times lower) (p13.L19-22)
rendered:
The review states that the energy density of LIBs has risen from 150 to 250 Wh kg−1, which is a factor of 1.67 (250/150). 

The battery cost has fallen from over $1000 kWh−1 in 2008 to around $130 kWh−1 in 2020, which is a factor of 7.69 (1000/130).
